errors.text_span: Each category has a pair of bars
errors.evidence: The chart does not show a pair of bars for each category. The 'Base' category has a single bar, and the 'CORG' and 'AdaCAD' categories have stacked bars.

errors.text_span: The "Base" category has a gray bar at approximately 58.8
errors.evidence: There is no gray bar for the 'Base' category in the figure. It only contains a single blue bar.

The description misinterprets the stacked bar for the 'CORG' category. The value 59 (or more accurately, 59.6) represents the total height of the stacked bar, not the value of the blue 'Ours' component alone.

The description misinterprets the stacked bar for the 'AdaCAD' category. The value 60.5 (or more accurately, 60.2) represents the total height of the stacked bar, not the value of the blue 'Ours' component alone.

errors.text_span: The bars are grouped by category, with the gray and blue bars appearing together for each method.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars for 'CORG' and 'AdaCAD' are stacked one on top of the other, not grouped side-by-side.
